brief: Use only this sense: sense 1; formal; especially people in authority. Do not use the organization-name sense; avoid two kindness synonyms in the same option set.
Use only this sense: sense 1; lifestyle or spending, not a small meal. Do not mix sense 1 with the separate meagre-meal sense.
Use only this sense: sense 1; firmness of purpose. Do not make physical strength the deciding meaning; focus on resolve.
Use only this sense: sense 1; speech or interview, not photography. A contextual item must exclude the unposed-photograph sense; do not offer both frank and honest.
Use only this sense: sense 1; formal; worker or student. Distinguish sustained effort from the meticulous target's attention to every detail; avoid both hardworking and industrious.
Use only this sense: sense 1; reception or attitude. Do not use business-takeover, military-territory or adverse-environment senses.
Use only this sense: sense 1; vegetation or population spread over an area. Use spatial context for dense; plentiful and abundant can be alternative quantity opposites, so avoid them together.
Use only this sense: sense 1; technology or method. Old alone does not imply disuse; do not offer both outdated and out of date.
Use only this sense: sense 1; formal; decision or course of action. Reckless is also a plausible antonym; do not offer both reckless and imprudent in an antonym set.
Use only this sense: sense 1; work, journey or experience. Dull is also a close synonym on the page; avoid boring and dull as competing keys.
Use only this sense: sense 1; approving; records, planning or craftsmanship. Fastidious is another dictionary synonym; keep it out of distractors for the same target.
Use only this sense: sense 1; formal or literary; journey or situation. Dangerous and hazardous can both be correct synonyms; include only one as the key.
Use only this sense: sense 1; task or journey requiring sustained effort. Avoid replacing exertion with danger: perilous is a different lexical skill.
Use only this sense: sense 1; ideas, thoughts or arguments. Clear is also definition-supported; do not put logical and clear in the same synonym set.
Use only this sense: sense 1; notice, object or feature; not the absence idiom. Avoid conspicuous by one's absence; visible and noticeable are both plausible synonyms.
Use only this sense: sense 1; inquiry, observer or decision. Neutral is another dictionary synonym; keep neutral and unbiased out of the same option set.
Use only this sense: sense 1; event or consequence; not the humorous expected habit sense. Certain is related but not always equivalent to unavoidability; lock the sense with context if necessary.
Use only this sense: sense 1; formal; place, scene or water. Calm and serene can both fit; do not offer both as synonym alternatives.

Use only this sense: sense 1; original painting or document, not an exact replica. Counterfeit is also a strong opposite in artwork context; avoid two valid opposites. Exclude sense 3, which permits an authentic model/replica.
Use only this sense: sense 1; pleased after good news. Joyful, jubilant and overjoyed can all be close; do not place multiple valid near-synonyms in one item.
Use only this sense: sense 1; a summary or statement, not an abridged-book label. Do not offer both brief and succinct; avoid terse as a competing key because it can imply abruptness.
Use only this sense: sense 1; personality, not biological group-living. Social and sociable can both fit; keep only one in the option set. Do not confuse enjoying company with benevolent generosity.

Use only this sense: sense 1; unpleasantly proud attitude. Do not use proud alone as a distractor if it could be interpreted as the source's intended sense. Preserve the unpleasant-superiority context.

Use only this sense: sense 1; physical condition or strength, not an unconvincing excuse. Frail is also plausible; do not put weak and frail together as synonym options. Do not use the weak-excuse sense without changing evidence.
Use only this sense: sense 1; duration, not a person moving from place to place. Fleeting is also an explicit synonym; do not put temporary and fleeting together.
